output.reason: The linked PR states the change: the port-forwarding helper in util/kube/portforwarder.go no longer port-forwards to pods that have Failed or are otherwise not ready [ev-033cda2ed80c, ev-859a23cd07ab, ev-730f43c1dcd3]. The linked issue gives the subject and who is exposed: the argocd CLI using direct access auth (port-forwarding) picked the first argocd-repo-server pod in the list, including evicted ghost pods with Init:ContainerStatusUnknown [ev-859eee04d430]. Without the fix, commands fail with "unable to upgrade connection: pod not found" until the stale pod is deleted [ev-8ce0ad2f5de9]. That is enough to write the subject (the CLI port-forward pod selection) and the applicability (direct-access/port-forward CLI use while the component has non-ready or failed pods), although the evidence does not name the exact flag.
